summary: Completed frontend E2E validation for GngWar landing page, responsive navigation, service pricing, booking modal, confirmation, and localStorage persistence. Production yarn build also passed.

integration_issues.issue: Continue Booking saves a booking when all customer fields are blank. Inputs have required attributes, but the button is not a submit control and onConfirm is called without validation.

action_items: Validate all booking fields before calling onConfirm, or use a form with a submit button so required constraints are enforced. Keep blank/incomplete requests from being persisted.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingModal declares required fields, but Continue Booking is a regular button and bypasses browser validation; this permits invalid persisted booking records.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; one TEST_ browser-local booking was created during E2E testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page, six pricing options across all 12 cards, modal duration updates, CTA entry points, confirmation/localStorage, required sections, mobile menu, and mobile overflow were tested successfully. Retest blank and partially completed booking submissions after validation is added.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open any booking modal, leave name/mobile/address/date/time empty, click Continue Booking. Confirmation appears and gngwar_booking is written. Root cause: required attributes only participate in native form submission; the current button directly invokes onConfirm and no explicit validation exists.
